translations.web: A fire goes before him, and burns up his adversaries on every side.
translations.bsb: Fire goes before Him and consumes His foes on every side.
translations.kjv: A fire goeth before him, and burneth up his enemies round about.
translations.asv: A fire goeth before him, And burneth up his adversaries round about.
